authored_assumptions: Original primitive-based full 3D design; no source mesh or photographic reconstruction.
Soft toy proportions and unseen back surfaces are authored.
Each visible part is rigidly weighted to one articulated bone; this is a controllable toy rig, not deforming skin or physical simulation.
Sketchbook pages are solid geometry; pencil motion conveys sketching without creating a dynamic ink texture.
Keyframe rotations and translations are expressed in model rest axes (X right, Y rear, Z up). The builder converts these offsets through each bone rest basis before writing Blender pose transforms.
Revision v2 uses visible toy elbow/knee joints and jointly authored shoulder/forearm/hand poses for a raised-tool celebration.
rest_pose: Authored default bone transforms. Blender Z-up/-Y-front exported to glTF Y-up/+Z-front.
